data_kind: real experimental spectra and real target-decoy peptide database subset

selection.rule: uniformly spaced eligible spectra in source order, including first and last; integer index floor(i*(N-1)/(K-1))

limits: Search assignments are not ground-truth annotations
Small-example FDR is not a performance estimate
The reduced FASTA preserves candidates only for these selected spectra and settings

reference_assignments.source: Corresponding unfiltered best-hit rows from the manuscript full-database search

peptide_database.source: Manuscript target-decoy peptide FASTA prepared from UniProt proteome UP000001940

data_attribution.license_note: Data attribution is separate from the repository code license; no new license is assigned to reused source data.
